description:
**Stamp duty (transfer duty) on a residential purchase in any state or territory**,
with every step shown: the general-rate duty, each concession or exemption
that applies, and the foreign purchaser surcharge.

**Who pays it:** the buyer, once, at settlement (or within the state's
deadline after it). It is usually the biggest up-front cost after the
deposit, and it varies widely with the buyer: the same home can cost a first
home buyer nothing under a state's exemption cap and a foreign buyer several
times the ordinary amount.

**What it covers:** the general scale; owner-occupier / home concessions;
first home buyer exemptions and concessions for established homes, new homes
and vacant land; off-the-plan, pensioner and income-tested schemes where a
state has them; and the foreign purchaser surcharge. Rates are those in force
on `contract_date` — each answer names the rates table version and the dates
it applies.

**Caveats:** an estimate for planning, not a duty assessment. It assumes one
buyer (or all buyers alike) and a home, not commercial or primary-production
land. Mortgage and transfer registration fees are separate and not included.
Each response lists what it assumed in `caveats`. For first home buyers,
`/calculators/first-home` sets the duty saving next to the grants.

**Price: 1¢ per call.**

buyer_type.description: `first_home` (first home buyer who will live in it), `owner_occupier` (will live in it, not a first home), `investor`, or `foreign` (a foreign person under state law — surcharge duty applies, no home concessions).

contract_date.description: Contract date (YYYY-MM-DD); picks the rates in force on that day. Default: today in Sydney.

dependants.description: Dependent children — raises an income-tested scheme's limit (ACT).

household_income.description: Gross household income for the past year — used by income-tested schemes (ACT). Omit and we assume you meet the income test.

off_the_plan.description: Bought off the plan. Changes the answer only where a state has an off-the-plan concession.

pensioner.description: Holds an eligible pension or concession card. Changes the answer only where a state has a pensioner concession.

price.description: Purchase price (or market value, if higher) in dollars.

property_type.description: `established` (an existing home), `new` (a new home or off-the-plan, never lived in), or `vacant_land` (land to build a home on).

regional.description: Outside the capital city (WA: outside Perth and Peel; also the WA grant's northern cap). Ignored where a state draws no such line.

state.description: State or territory: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT.
